description: Create a KV store with its first entry (max 1 MiB per value, 1,000 keys); the key `hosting` is reserved. Returns the share link, the owner token and manageUrl (private: its holder can edit or delete). Owner tokens and management links never go into published content.

namespace.description: Omit (default): private. `public`: the shared public namespace. JSON and KV are never listed in the gallery or indexed; anyone with the link can open it. A custom name: 1-32 of a-z, 0-9, hyphen.

ownerToken.description: Owner token of an earlier create

ttlDays.description: Days to keep it: up to 30 days without an account, up to 90 with a free profile (an ownerToken held in the profile). Omitted: the default. The result states the expiry.

name: publish_kv
title: Publish KV entry
